relay.scope: Finite offer driver applies the existing application NSDP16 rule from real NWK state; pre-admitted fixed-route production NWK custody/HOP/MAC service with controlled successful addressed transport; excludes full application-generator parity, security admission, route convergence, RF collisions, half-duplex loss, PHY/ECC validation and stochastic population equivalence

clock.scope: Actual production MAC counters and scheduler FIFO; prescribed reservation ingress and neighbor occupancy leave historical modulo-probe slot 16 free. No forced-slot override. The continuous case intentionally retains the MATLAB binary64 residual. Only the quantized controlled-transport comparison uses integer nanoseconds. No global clock, RF, HOP or NWK parity claim.
